items.title: What balance of access and dependable staffing is workable?
items.body: Explore what affordable participation and reliable opening hours each require. Operating costs, likely usage and volunteer availability remain unknown; the group may weigh these priorities differently.

items.title: Protect access for people with little spare income
items.body: One possible perspective would prioritise low fees and participation. This framing has not been confirmed by any member, and its financial implications still need evidence.

items.title: Make opening hours dependable
items.body: Another possible perspective would prioritise predictable staffing and access. This is a tentative framing, not an attributed statement or proof that paid staffing is the only way to provide reliability.

items.title: Explore a bounded pilot before long-term commitments
items.body: A possible approach is to compare a small set of fee and staffing arrangements in a limited trial, with agreed observations about cost, participation and reliability. Whether to run such a trial, and what it should measure, remain open questions.
